proposals.failure_mode: Contrastive pressure may misalign with ranking and dilute top-k discrimination, or message-transform layers may be too costly/unstable for Pilot constraints and underperform simpler propagation.
proposals.hypothesis: A structurally distinct message-transform graph encoder with light residual propagation and an auxiliary graph-view contrastive objective can uncover signal beyond standard latent-factor or light-propagation baselines by improving representation anisotropy and robustness without changing the ML-1M full-sort protocol.
